description: Where a connected domain points (any connected domain, bought here or brought). Without route_order, app_ref or app_hash it reads the current routing. route_order is the serve chain tried in order: tunnel (the agent's own server, when online), p2p (the app from peers), site (the app from the broker). app_ref "author/name" serves that miniapp's current version and follows new publishes; app_hash pins one version; null clears either. Warnings say when a rung can never serve.

agent_id.description: The agent the domain is connected to — you must control it

app_hash.description: A pinned app version hash, or null to clear

app_ref.description: A published miniapp as "author/name" (as in /app/<author>/<name>), or null to clear

route_order.description: The serve chain, e.g. ["site","tunnel"] to serve an app and fall back to the agent

name: domain_routing
title: Point a connected domain
